headline: Tyreek Hill expected to sign with team soon, agent says
summary: Free agent wide receiver Tyreek Hill will sign with a new "over the next few days," his agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter. Hill's former team, the Chiefs, are believed to be one of the team's interested.

headline: Vikings make history at 4-0 -- without a scoring offense
summary: Minnesota sits atop the NFC North despite its special teams outscoring its offense the past three weeks.

headline: How the Rams, Cowboys, Patriots pulled Week 4 comebacks to save their seasons
summary: The Rams, Cowboys and Pats were all looking at 1-3 ... then everything changed. How did a trio of stunning rallies play out -- and are these teams all back on track at 2-2?

headline: Reports: Broncos believe Pat Surtain II avoided long-term injury
summary: Broncos cornerback Pat Surtain II had to leave Sunday's 24-14 loss after the kind of non-contact injury that gives rise to thoughts of long-term absences, but early word is positive about Surtain's condition.

headline: Tetairoa McMillan, Bryce Young star as Panthers defeat Lions
summary: Carolina receiver Tetairoa McMillan was dominant in his team's 32-36 win over Detroit Lions Sunday night, catching 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns from teammate Bryce Young, who threw for 329 yards to help the Panthers even their record at 2-2.

headline: Mike Macdonald: Seven personal fouls "unacceptable on any level"
summary: The Seahawks had a 21-point lead over the Chargers in the third quarter on Sunday, but the Chargers had the ball with a chance to tie or win the game with less than two minutes to play.
